prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for most specific kinds of change, as only 'finish, new_screen', 'home, wait_info', 'adoption, notification', 'sign_in, incentive', and 'choose_path, copy' have been tested more than once.
'finish, new_screen' is consistently helpful, supported by two winning tests (+7.3% average after noise correction).
'home, wait_info' is helpful, with two winning tests out of three (+3.4% average after noise correction).
No clear effect was seen for both 'adoption, notification' and 'sign_in, incentive', as tests for these kinds showed no clear effect.
Results for 'choose_path, copy' remain inconsistent across tests (one lost: worse, one won), so no clear pattern is established.
Predictions were generally too high overall, though they underpredicted gains on several winning tests (such as in 'home, wait_info' and 'choose_path, copy').

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Companion Interactive Tutorial Screen: Add a dedicated tutorial screen after home intro showing users how to interact with, move, and hide their desktop pet. (why: Lessons show finish + new_screen is consistently positive (+7.3%), and support emails report confusion on how to control or hide the pet after setup.)
1: [home, wait_info] Live Generation Progress and Pet Assembly Tips: Show a live progress status bar and generation hint on the waiting screen while the desktop pet renders. (why: Lessons highlight home wait_info as a winning strategy (+3.4% average), addressing the heavy mean wait time (2336s) on the waiting screen.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Deferred Account Creation Order Change: Move sign-in after pet adoption selection so users bond with their chosen pet before creating an account. (why: Moving account friction after pet selection reduces early drop-off while preserving account safety.)
3: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Overlay and Placement Setup Screen: Add a screen allowing users to pick whether their pet rests on the taskbar, floats over windows, or stays in the tray. (why: Finish screens consistently boost completion (+7.3%), and support emails report confusion about where pets appear on desktop.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Pet Recovery Guidance Hint: Add a text hint on sign-in clarifying that logging in restores all existing pets and settings automatically. (why: Support mail has 8 explicit complaints regarding pets missing or resetting after signing in again.)
5: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Trait and Personality Customization Screen: Insert a personality trait selection screen during adoption to let users define pet behaviors before rendering. (why: Adoption conversion is weak (60.9%); adding interactive personalization builds emotional investment before the waiting phase.)
6: [home, wait_info] System Tray Launch Notification Status: Display desktop tray notification toggle and status update on the waiting screen so users know how to locate the pet upon launch. (why: Supported by positive trend in home wait_info tests (+3.4%) and support mail regarding pet visibility and launch questions.)
7: [finish, redesign] Interactive Desktop Pet Command Playground Redesign: Redesign home intro into a stage layout playground where users test pet actions before leaving onboarding. (why: Home intro finish step benefits from big redesign moves, solving user post-onboarding confusion around controlling the pet.)
